digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — acceptance criteria evidence classification
propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion item as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested based on whether completion evidence can be verified in the repository.
Criteria with externally-sourced proof require the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag; missing or malformed tags on external criteria must produce findings with remediation guidance.
Codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] must produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.
Mixed-evidence criteria that bundle both repository and external proof must be rejected and require splitting into independently certifiable criteria.
Misclassification findings must participate in normal plan-review blocking policy, while the existing P6 deterministic lexicon remains advisory/fail-open.

Frozen-corpus evaluation must achieve 100% precision on genuine-external negatives, 100% recall on named test cases (A1, 115b, 8c4f, malformed tags, over-tagged code, mixed evidence), and ≥0.90 macro precision/recall across all samples.
